name: William Richard McAvoy
bioAdditions: A second, independent licence confirms his New York birth: daughter Agnes M. McAvoy's 1914 Luzerne docket gives her father William as deceased and born in "New York" (S1), matching Elizabeth's 1923 licence. FamilySearch attaches a Social Security NUMIDENT entry for William Richard McAvoy (almost certainly William Jr., 1886-1942) in which the father's name appears as "William R McAvoy"; the SS-5 application behind it would give the son's birth date and both parents' names (S2).

conflicts.assessment: Two licences (1914, 1923) given by different daughters both say New York; keep New York. The FS "Pennsylvania" is unsourced.
A father born c.1845 could not have a son in 1857. The Peter McAvoy/Mary Doran parentage is unsourced on FamilySearch and its dates are impossible; treat as unverified, possibly a wrong family.

openQuestionsNew: NUMIDENT/SS-5 for William Richard McAvoy Jr. (1886-1942) would name the parents and may give William Sr.'s full name.

1899 death in Plymouth predates state registration: look for a Luzerne County Register of Deaths entry (1893-1906) and a St. Vincent de Paul, Plymouth burial; obituary in the Wilkes-Barre Record / Times, 5-7 Nov 1899.
